en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a medieval statue shown from both the front and the back. The front view shows a female figure in long robes, while the reverse view reveals detailed carvings, potentially depicting a moral message. The text below the photos identifies the location and subject. The card has a classical, scalloped border typical of older postcards.
